Kill a [[Dragon Lich]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill a Dragon Lich in the [[Great Battle Field]].
* *BONUS* Kill a Dragon Lich in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 30 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
A Dragon Lich is found in the [[Fissure of Woe]] guarding the entrances of the Shadow Army encampment at the Great Battle Field.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Zaishen Bounty
:''"Kill a Dragon Lich in the Great Battle Field."''
